title: Keep suggestion tracking undecided
text: The explicit open JOURNEYS question is whether once-per-session and do-not-ask-again tracking is wanted or agent judgment replaces it. Reusable execution instructions are a different existing mechanism; they do not establish a general reminder-memory store. No tracker or dismissal behavior is shipped or certified by this record.
plan_notes: JOURNEYS question 1: Is the once-per-session and "don't ask again" tracking (former G) still wanted, or does agent judgment under principle 3 replace it?
